name: Ashita mo Kitto Hare♪
source:
Main character goes to school in a small seaside town. Swimming, sunbathing, culture festival... there are many events to enjoy in summer. Tomorrow will definitely be sunny.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一座临海小镇上学。游泳、日光浴、文化祭…夏天里有许许多多值得享受的活动。明天也一定会是晴天。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
